about_the_game:
In recent months, an eerie stillness has fallen over the city. Women are vanishing without a trace, only to be found later in the forest — heartless, marked with a burned noose on their bodies. The police are helpless, and the locals dare not speak of it aloud.

You are an artist, once inspired, now cursed. Your dreams have turned into vivid nightmares, visions of things that shouldn’t exist… or perhaps already have. Ancient forces whisper through your mind, growing stronger, closer — as if something is trying to break through, using you as its vessel.

Where does reality end and madness begin? Can you uncover the truth behind the victims before losing yourself? Or are you just a brush in the hand of darkness?

Vorozhey is shrouded in an atmosphere of ominous silence, where reality dissolves into ancient myths and personal nightmares. The creaking floorboards, whispers from the dark, and haunting visions make you question your own sanity.

  • Psychological horror

  • Slavic mythology

  • Uncover the mystery of the city
